name: Huntington Library, Art Museum, and Botanical Gardens
tagline: 120 acres of gardens, a Gainsborough collection, and a Gutenberg Bible.
description: Henry Huntington's San Marino estate split into three: a research library (with one of 50 surviving Gutenberg Bibles), an art collection of British and French portraiture (Blue Boy by Gainsborough, Pinkie by Lawrence), and 120 acres of themed gardens.
review_long:
Effectively three museums on one ticket: a rare books library where you can see one of 50 surviving Gutenberg Bibles, an art collection of British grand-manner portraiture (Blue Boy and Pinkie hang facing each other), and 16 themed botanical gardens — including the largest Chinese garden outside China and a desert garden with 5,000 species.

A full day. The tea room books up weeks ahead.

tips.text: Allow at least 4 hours. The Chinese and Japanese gardens are at opposite ends of the estate.

distance_landmark: San Marino, 30 minutes east of downtown LA
